name: Aida Momo
source: The protagonist's little sister. When their parents go on vacation for a week she gets to be alone with her brother. She waits excitedly but after several days he hasn't made a move on her! Desperate to break his taboo against incest she puts on a collar and tells her onii-chan that she'll do whatever he says!
